realmbridge.title: Bedrock Realms
realmbridge.button.open.tooltip: Join a Bedrock Edition realm from Java Edition.
realmbridge.signin.blurb: Sign in with the Microsoft account that owns the Bedrock realm, or that the invite was sent to.
realmbridge.devicecode.instructions: Go to %s and enter this code:
realmbridge.devicecode.open.tooltip: Opens your browser with the code already filled in.
realmbridge.devicecode.waiting: Waiting for you to finish signing in...
realmbridge.devicecode.expired: This code has expired. Start the sign-in again.
realmbridge.realms.empty: No Bedrock realms on this account yet. Paste an invite code below to join one.
realmbridge.realms.more: ...and %s more. Accept fewer invites or use /realmbridge play <name>.
realmbridge.realm.tooltip.incompatible: This realm runs a Bedrock version the bridge can't translate yet.

realmbridge.status.settling: Waiting for the realm to finish starting...
realmbridge.status.downloading: Downloading the bridge (~45 MB, one time)...
realmbridge.debug.button.tooltip: Bridge maintenance and diagnostics, without needing to be in a world.
realmbridge.debug.title: RealmBridge Debug
realmbridge.debug.update.tooltip: Re-download the patched ViaProxy and plugin, replacing what is installed.
realmbridge.debug.updated: Bridge updated. Try joining the realm again.
realmbridge.debug.invites.tooltip: Ask the Realms API for invitations this account has not accepted.
realmbridge.debug.audited: Invite audit written to the log.
realmbridge.debug.diagnostics.tooltip: Write versions, paths and the signed-in Xbox account to the log.
